label: 008-vault: the secrets name grammar is referenced six times across spec/plan/goal and defined nowhere; only the negative case (../etc/passwd) is pinned, so a builder invents the regex that also decides the env key.
008-vault: the SKILLED_BOT_SECRET_<NAME> mapping rule is unstated; AC-007 pins only demo->DEMO, and translation versus grammar-restriction are not equivalent because translated names can collide.

008-vault: secret-too-long and secret-store-unreadable exist only in edge-case prose with no REQ id and no AC row, yet goal.md:63 verifies secret-too-long, so a REQ-faithful build fails its own goal check.

008-vault: the store on-disk shapes (index.json entries keyed by name, <name>.value, {backend,createdAt,updatedAt}) are pinned only inside AC-002 and one plan sentence, with no schema section, no version field and no statement of what list prints.

008-vault: the phase changes the meaning of an existing field with no migration or rollback; bots already carrying a secrets: line stop running with secret-unknown exit 4, and there is no operator step, no declared-but-unstored audit verb and no rollback note.
008-vault: the index has no concurrency rule; set/forget read-modify-write one index.json with no lock, though the runtime already carries the temp-write-then-rename convention.

008-vault: the keychain backend names only add-generic-password; delete-generic-password is never named for forget, and --store semantics on forget/list are undefined when the recorded backend differs from the flag.
008-vault: the redaction form and the withheld run outcome are unspecified; REQ-014 does not say what replaces the value, whether the record status changes, or what bots run exits with.
